items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVE-2026-53787) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, rated 9.8 (critical), allowing remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B and Magento Open Source
items.summary: APSB26-49 fixes 15 CVEs, including critical Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) leading to arbitrary code execution and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) leading to arbitrary file system write. Adobe rates this bulletin Priority 2.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable files disguised as images to any store. Adobe has released Magento 2.4.9 containing the fix, but older supported release lines remain vulnerable.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including incorrect authorization (CVE-2026-21284), improper access control (CVE-2026-21285), and stored XSS (CVE-2026-21310), which could lead to full system takeover, data leaks, and admin hijacking. Adobe recommends applying security patches as quickly as possible.
